_meta.note: Maintenance: WV-area averages originally from RepairPal + AAA Your Driving Costs 2024 (+5% for mountain road conditions), inflated 2026-09-23 for repair-cost growth (BLS CPI motor vehicle maintenance & repair +14% over two years): oil, brakes, misc ×1.15; tires ×1.05 (tire CPI ~flat). Insurance: estimated full-coverage annual premium for a 35-45 year old with a clean record in WV, scaled 2026-09-23 against 2026 WV averages (NerdWallet $2,144, Bankrate $2,162, ValuePenguin $2,148, Insurify $1,862): sedans ×1.15, SUVs/minivans ×1.25, pickups and Jeep Wrangler ×1.08. Actual rates vary widely by driver history, coverage level, and ZIP code. tank_gallons: usable tank capacity for refueling-time calculation.
